known.summary: archive reads the latest ClosedEvent closer only as a Commit, so when GitHub drops a same-repository keyword closer from the excludeUserLinked connection and records the closer as the pull request itself, archive ignores that merged pull request and refuses a legitimately merged plan.

step accepts only an ongoing plan, but once the merge closes the issue the plan derives as finished while archive still demands every step terminal, so a step left non-terminal at merge can never be repaired and the closed plan deadlocks (reopening would discard the closure proof archive needs).

retire closes the issue as not planned before it removes the phase labels, so a failed label cleanup strands a closed issue with a stale phase label, and the closed-issue guard then refuses every retire retry, leaving the cleanup unrecoverable through the CLI.

edit rewrites the export's .origin digest before the remote body write, so when gh issue edit fails the sidecar names a body GitHub never received and a retry with the same file is refused as a stale export, forcing a re-export that overwrites the edited file.
